Gold.note: Central bank accumulation and lower real rates support further upside.

Silver.note: Robust industrial demand and monetary premium drive outperformance.

Copper.note: Structural electrification demand offsets near-term manufacturing softness.

Uranium.note: Persistent structural supply deficit and global nuclear capacity expansions.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and moderating EV demand growth weigh on prices.

Nickel.note: Surplus from Indonesian supply growth outpaces battery demand.

Zinc.note: Plummeting smelter treatment charges indicate tight concentrate supply.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector and high port inventories cap upside.

Coal.note: Long-term energy transition pressures offset by near-term baseload resilience.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks balanced by weak offshore manufacturing demand.

Manganese.note: Soft global steel production and adequate supply limit price appreciation.

PGM.note: Battery electric vehicle transition structurally threatens long-term auto catalyst demand.

Potash.note: Stable global agricultural demand balances normalized supply chains.

Aluminum.note: Tight primary smelter capacity and green transition demand support prices.

Diversified.note: Strong exposure to copper and gold offsets iron ore and steel weakness.
